carbonpilot.summary: A five-person Google AI & Technology Academy graduation project: carbon accounting for CBAM exporters with deterministic emission calculations and a guarded LangGraph agent. My part: the agent graph with loop, timeout and fallback guards, Gemini extraction, LangSmith tracing and the PDF/JSON reports.
